## Validation and limitations

No known relevant articles were supplied. A targeted search found a prior systematic review on chelators and zinc, but the skill’s reference-neighbor command returned no included-study candidates. I screened 50 records from a therapy-focused pilot sample and 30 records in the therapy-category probe; none was added as an eligible known record. The probe therefore found **0 relevant records among 30 screened**, but that small sample does not establish completeness.

**Recall was not estimated; the strategy is empirically unvalidated.** The draft received three independent PRESS-structured internal critique rounds; a broader zinc MeSH heading was added and the finding was resolved. Human PRESS peer review by an information specialist is still pending.
